addsFundsToThisSmartWallet: Adds funds to this smart wallet.
allowanceRouteExplanation: This sends funds using the allowance already saved on this wallet.
allowanceStartingPoint: Open a wallet that lists the connected wallet as a spender.
allowanceWhenToUse: Use this when the connected wallet has a spending allowance.
beneficiaryDistributionDescription: Pay one fund pool to the saved recovery destinations. All recovery contacts must be unlocked.
beneficiaryDistributionOutcome: Each recovery contact receives its exact share and keeps its recovery rights.
beneficiaryDistributionRouteExplanation: Pay exact shares from one fund pool to every recovery contact. Scheduled payments must be settled first.
beneficiaryDistributionStartingPoint: Select one fund pool and review every payout.
beneficiaryDistributionWhatChanges: One fund pool is paid to the saved destinations. Recovery contacts and shares stay the same.
beneficiaryDistributionWhenToUse: Use this after scheduled payments are settled and one fund pool can split exactly.
beneficiaryStopDescription: Stop future accrual for one scheduled payment as an unlocked recovery contact.
beneficiaryStopOutcome: The payment stops at the reviewed cutoff. Its unpaid debt remains.
beneficiaryStopRouteExplanation: Use an unlocked recovery contact to stop one scheduled payment. Earned funds remain owed.
beneficiaryStopStartingPoint: Select a scheduled payment, preview its cutoff and debt, then confirm.
beneficiaryStopWhatChanges: Only one payment end date and the shared cooldown change. No funds are paid out.
beneficiaryStopWhenToUse: Before settling scheduled payments during recovery.
castsTheVoteAndCarriesTheWalletState: Casts the vote and carries the wallet state forward.
castsTheVoteYouPasteOnACardano: Casts the vote you paste on a Cardano governance proposal, on this wallet's behalf. The wallet's rules and people do not change.
changesOnlyTheScheduledPaymentsPeopleAnd: Changes only the scheduled payments. People and other wallet settings stay unchanged.
collectAdaRewardsEarnedFromStaking: Collect ADA rewards earned from staking.
collectsStakingRewardsWhileKeepingThisWa: Collects staking rewards while keeping this wallet's rules in sync.
consolidateRouteExplanation: This reorganizes selected fund pools without changing the wallet balance.
consolidateStartingPoint: Open a wallet, then choose which fund pools to reorganize.
consolidateWhenToUse: Use this to reorganize fund pools, or move one pool from an old address.
createsOneOrMoreFundPoolsAtThe: Creates one or more fund pools at the wallet address.
createsTheWalletAndAddsItsFirstFunds: Creates the wallet and adds its first funds.
createsTheWalletNameOwnersOptionalRecove: Creates the wallet name, owners, optional recovery contacts, and first balance.
editPeopleRecoveryAndTheProofOfLife: Edit people, recovery, and the proof of life.
enableStakingReceiptSummary: You are turning on staking for this wallet, so its funds can be delegated to a pool.
enableStakingRouteExplanation: This turns on staking by setting the wallet's stake address, so its funds can be delegated to a stake pool.
enableStakingStartingPoint: Open the wallet, then confirm enabling staking.
enableStakingWhenToUse: Use this once to make a wallet stakeable, before delegating its funds to a pool.
fundsStayInTheWalletTheyEndUp: Funds stay in the wallet. Their total value does not change.
getTheAddressOrAddMoney: Get the address or add money.
lockFundsRouteExplanation: This shows the wallet receive address and lets you add funds.
lockFundsStartingPoint: Start by copying the receive address. Use the form only when you want to add funds from the connected wallet.
lockFundsWhenToUse: Use this when someone needs to send assets into the wallet, or when you want to add funds yourself.
manageStreamingPaymentsRouteExplanation: This adds or updates scheduled payments.
manageStreamingPaymentsStartingPoint: Open a wallet, then add or edit the scheduled payments.
manageStreamingPaymentsWhenToUse: Use this when you need to add, renew, pause, or edit a scheduled payment.
mergeSmallFundPoolsIntoOneToSave: Reorganize selected fund pools without changing the wallet balance.
mergesTheWalletSFundPoolsOrMoves: Reorganizes the wallet's fund pools, or moves one back to the wallet's main address.
mintRouteExplanation: This creates a new smart wallet and prepares it for receiving funds.
mintStartingPoint: Check the name, owners, and starter funds before continuing.
mintWhenToUse: Start here when you need a new smart wallet.
movesTheProofOfLifeForwardWithinThe: Moves the proof of life forward within the allowed renewal window.
payWhatAScheduledPaymentOwes: Pay what a scheduled payment owes.
payoutRouteExplanation: This pays what a scheduled payment owes and records the payment.
payoutStartingPoint: Open a wallet with scheduled payments, then choose the due payments.
payoutWhenToUse: Use this when a scheduled payment is due.
paysWhatOneOrMoreScheduledPaymentsOwe: Pays what one or more scheduled payments owe, from this wallet.
proofOfLifeReceiptSummary: You are checking in, which pushes the proof of life back. No money moves.
proofOfLifeRouteExplanation: This refreshes the wallet proof of life.
proofOfLifeStartingPoint: Open a wallet, then review the new proof of life before confirming.
proofOfLifeWhenToUse: Use this when someone needs to show the wallet is still in use.
publishReceiptSummary: You are publishing a governance certificate from this wallet.
publishRouteExplanation: This publishes an advanced governance certificate.
publishStartingPoint: Open a wallet, then paste the certificate payload.
publishWhenToUse: Use this for advanced governance or stake certificate operations that should be authorized by the smart wallet.
publishesTheCertificateAndCarriesTheWall: Publishes the certificate and carries the wallet state forward.
recipientsGetPaidAndTheWalletRecordsThe: Recipients get paid and the wallet records the payment.
recoveryContactRouteExplanation: This sends funds using the recovery-contact rules on this wallet.
recoveryContactStartingPoint: Open a wallet where the connected wallet is an active recovery contact.
recoveryContactWhenToUse: Use this when the connected wallet is listed as a recovery contact and the wallet is unlocked.
refreshesTheWalletProofOfLifeWithoutSend: Refreshes the wallet proof of life without sending funds.
registerTheWalletForStakingOrGovernance: Register the wallet for staking or governance.
rewardsAreCollectedAndTheWalletStateIs: Rewards are collected and the wallet state is carried forward without changing everyday rules.
savesChangesToPeopleRecoveryContactsAppr: Saves changes to people, recovery contacts, approvals, or the proof of life.
savesTheSchedulePayingWhatItOwesIs: Saves the schedule. Paying what it owes is a separate step.
sendsFundsUsingTheWalletSRecoveryContact: Sends funds using the wallet's recovery-contact rules.
sendsFundsWithinOneSpenderSDailyLimit: Sends funds within one spender's daily limit.
sendsSelectedFundsToARecipientWhileKeepi: Sends selected funds to a recipient while keeping wallet rules unchanged.
sendsTheCertificateYouPasteToCardanoOn: Sends the certificate you paste to Cardano, on this wallet's behalf. The wallet's rules and people do not change.
setTheWalletSStakeAddressSoIt: Set the wallet's stake address so it can delegate.
theRecipientGetsPaidAndTheRemainingAllow: The recipient gets paid and the remaining allowance is updated.
theRecipientReceivesTheAssetsYouChoosePe: The recipient receives the assets you choose. People, scheduled payments, and the proof of life stay the same.
theRecoveryContactReceivesFundsUpToThe: Earlier recovery contacts withdraw once and are removed. The final recovery contact keeps access to remaining funds and later deposits.
theWalletSStakeAddressIsSetExisting: The wallet's stake address is set; existing funds are then moved to the new staking address and can be delegated.
turnsOnStakingByRecordingTheWalletS: Turns on staking by recording the wallet's own staking script as its stake address.
updateStateRouteExplanation: This updates people, the proof of life, and other wallet rules.
updateStateStartingPoint: Open a wallet, choose the section you want to edit, then review the changes.
updateStateWhenToUse: Use this when you want to change who can use the wallet or how the wallet is protected.
updatesWalletSettingsExistingFundsStayIn: Updates wallet settings. Existing funds stay in the wallet unless you choose a send action separately.
useRouteExplanation: This is the normal send flow for this wallet.
useStartingPoint: Open a wallet, choose Send, then pick the recipient and amount.
useWhenToUse: Use this for normal payments when you are allowed to send from the wallet.
voteOnACardanoGovernanceProposal: Vote on a Cardano governance proposal.
voteReceiptSummary: You are casting this wallet's vote on a governance action.
voteRouteExplanation: This casts an advanced governance vote.
voteStartingPoint: Open a wallet, then paste the vote payload.
voteWhenToUse: Use this for advanced governance votes that should be authorized by the smart wallet.
withdrawRouteExplanation: This collects staking rewards for this wallet.
withdrawStartingPoint: Open the wallet, then enter the staking address and reward amount.
withdrawWhenToUse: Use this when this wallet should claim available staking rewards.
